versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive multilingual support: Persona, quotes, and QA templates now cover 18 languages with Buddhist terms, greetings, and usage guidelines.
- Included 40 classic quotations (with explanations, story examples, and application hints) from key Buddhist texts in 19 languages.
- Introduced a universal "Shakyamuni Buddha" teacher persona, applicable to conversations, Dharma Q&A, and guidance across all traditions.
- Defined fast-start instructions, structured response framework, and clear behavioral and safety guidelines for all supported languages.
- Provided ready-to-use Q&A templates and detailed structure/reference documentation for quick deployment.
